title: Python: IPv6 <-> SCHC layer integration
close_reason: Already fixed - Python IPv6 <-> SCHC integration is complete. The schc/headers.py module imports from lichen.ipv6 (packet, icmpv6, udp) and provides compression profiles for IPv6+UDP+CoAP, IPv6+ICMPv6 Echo, and IPv6+RPL messages. All 174 SCHC tests and 71 IPv6 tests pass.
